-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.RawNode__Advance` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem ackSnapLog_facts (ls : LogState) (m : MessageM) (t : w64) (sv : SnapshotM) (Hsn : ls.snap =
    some (snapId sv)) (Hap : uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index') (Happ : uint.Z
    ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.applying) : (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).snap = none ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t
    sv).sip = false ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).sat = false ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).applying =
    sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).applied = sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t
    sv).unpersisted = ls.unpersisted ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).prev = ls.prev ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t
    sv).stored = ls.stored ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).storage = ls.storage ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).fl
    = ls.fl ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).committed = ls.committed ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).lent =
    ls.lent

theorem RawNode.Advance.wp_proof [package_sem : Assumptions] (wp_raft_Step : raft.Step.spec) :
    RawNode.Advance.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.RawNode.Advance.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (γ : RaftNames) (rn : Loc) (id : w64) (rs : RNState) (rd : Ready),
    (rs.slent = none → rs.unpersisted = []) →
      rs.unst = false →
        (rs.mode.isDyn = true → NoConfIn rs.delivered rs.capplied rs.delivered.length) →
          (∀ (l : SnapLoan), rs.slent = some l → rs.mode.isDyn = true → l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave' = false) →
            ⊢
              ∀ Φ,
                isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗ "Hrn" ∷ ownRawNode γ rn id rs ∗ "Hret" ∷ loanRet rs -∗
                  (▷
                      ∀ t ca,
                        ownRawNode γ rn id (advRS rs t ca) ∗
                            ⌜uint.Z rs.term ≤ uint.Z t ∧ uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z rs.term + 1⌝ ∗
                              ⌜uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z rs.tc⌝ ∗
                                ⌜(rs.slent = none → rs.capplied ≤ ca ∧ ca ≤ max rs.capplied rs.delivered.length) ∧
                                    (∀ (l : SnapLoan), rs.slent = some l → rs.mode.isDyn = true → ca = l.dlv.length) ∧
                                      (rs.mode = RNMode.static → ca = rs.capplied)⌝ -∗
                          Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                    WP
                      ((intoVal
                          (methods RawNode.ty.PointerType go!"Advance" (intoVal rn)))
                        (intoVal rd))
                      {{ Φ }}

theorem ackSnapLog_facts_miss (ls : LogState) (m : MessageM) (t : w64) (sv : SnapshotM) (Hhit :
    snapHit ls.snap sv.Metadata'.Index' = false) (Hsat : ls.sat = false) (Hmiss : ∀ (id' : entryID),
    ackStableId m t = some id' → ¬StableHit ls id') (Hap : uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z
    sv.Metadata'.Index') (Happ : uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.applying) : (ackSnapLog ls m t
    sv).snap = ls.snap ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).sip = ls.sip ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).sat = false ∧
    (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).applying = sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).applied =
    sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).unpersisted = ls.unpersisted ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t
    sv).prev = ls.prev ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).stored = ls.stored ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).storage
    = ls.storage ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).fl = ls.fl ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).committed =
    ls.committed ∧ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).lent = ls.lent

theorem ackSnapLog_snap (ls : LogState) (m : MessageM) (t : w64) (sv : SnapshotM) : (ackSnapLog ls m
    t sv).snap = ls.snap ∨ (ackSnapLog ls m t sv).snap = none
